text: What did the hyperparameter-scan lab conclude when comparing random search (50 samples) with the 80-point grid search on NARMA-10?
choices: Grid search always finds a dramatically better optimum than random search
Random search failed to find any usable configuration
Random search reliably found a configuration within ~10% of the grid-search optimum
Random search needed more evaluations than the grid to match it
explanation: The lab observes random search with 50 samples lands within ≈10% of the grid optimum while covering the continuous space more efficiently, because performance depends on only a few dimensions (Bergstra & Bengio 2012). It used fewer evaluations (50 vs 80), not more.
